Subject: Re: New vendor submission and payment terms inquiry

Hi Rachel — thanks for sending the intake and W-9.

Quick notes on Redwood's standard onboarding & payment flow:
- Default net terms for new vendors are Net45 while we complete vendor validation (credit & tax checks) and PO gating.
- We require invoices to include the PO number and a clear remit-to (bank ACH) or EFT instructions; without PO the invoice is routed to exception and delays payment.
- For early-pay requests we run a short pilot with Finance; please provide a bank routing/beneficiary PDF so billing can validate.

Action items for NimbleOps: please attach a scanned bank details template (or request our secure upload) and confirm your invoice frequency (one consolidated invoice per month vs invoice per PO). Also indicate whether you require any specific remit notes or a third-party factoring partner.

I'll loop in David (Finance) to scope the early-pay pilot and confirm economics. Once validated we can move forward with vendor code creation and first PO.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
Contracts & Vendor Ops

Hi Rachel — great to meet you over email. A couple of items from Finance perspective: 

1) Early-pay economics: Redwood typically offers an early-pay program calibrated to cashflow and unit economics. For a 15-day remittance, Finance can support an early-pay pilot at 1.25% fee (effectively a 1.25% discount on the invoice) rather than 2%, for a 90-day pilot window. If NimbleOps is amenable we'll treat this as a charge applied at payment and show the net remittance on the remittance advice.

2) PO & invoice routing: please ensure every invoice includes the Redwood PO number and the line-level PO reference on each line item so our AP automation routes correctly. If you submit a consolidated monthly invoice, include a separate section per PO with PO numbers and dates.

3) Operational cadence: proposed mutual action plan below — can you confirm target dates?
- May 31: vendor portal ID & vendor code assigned (vendor to confirm bank details uploaded)
- June 05: acceptance of early-pay pilot terms (DocuSign link provided)
- June 10: first PO issued (standard Net45 until pilot activated)
- June 25: first invoice under pilot processed (if pilot active, payment on day 15 with 1.25% fee applied)

If this works, I'll kick off vendor creation and send the DocuSign for the pilot amendment. Monica from Vendor Ops is on copy and will manage vendor setup.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
